pattern: revise the draft the agent read
experience: An agent edit could overwrite a newer draft because the draft tool did not expose the reviewed revision.
rule: Pass the revision read from the existing draft when editing it.

source.note: Mail action history and undo review

prompt: On T3 Mail thread mail-acme, change the day in the existing reply draft from Thursday to Friday. Leave it for my review.

pattern: forward an older message in a thread
experience: An agent asked to forward an earlier email in a thread could only draft a reply to the newest message, because the draft tool had no target or forward mode.
rule: Forward the message the user named by passing its messageId as targetMessageId with mode forward, and leave the quoted original out of the body.

messages.text: Here is the invoice for October.

prompt: On T3 Mail thread mail-invoice, forward Ellen's email with the October invoice to accountant@example.org with a short note asking them to file it. Leave it for my review.
